info.syllabusName: Quản trị bán hàng trong nhà hàng khách sạn (Sales Management in Hospitality Industry)
info.description:
- The course of sales management in addition to providing
students with basic knowledge about sales profession, career path in the field
of sales, managers in sales, also help students build relationships. in sales
communication;
- Equip and train students in communication skills in sales;
- Helping students in the role of administrators can analyze
the indicators of sales strategies: sales targets, costs, .. in sales; sales
team management; evaluate performance

- Present a sales business plan for a specific project.
